title: BankManifest

name.description: A bank's name: 1 to 40 characters of lower-case letters, digits and single hyphens between them, unique per environment.

kind.description: A bank's kind: personal (one person's own) or team (shared, reviewed by its owners).

purpose.description: The bank line every run sees: what the bank is for, one line of at most 160 characters.

folder.description: A scope folder as a pointer names it, relative to projects/: org/, org/project/ or org/project/area/, ending in a slash.

items.description: An entity a bank holds facts about: its name, its aliases (matched whole-word and case-insensitive against the first message and the repository identity) and, optionally, the scope folder a match expands.
A memory's name: a lower-case slug of at most 60 characters, its file's name (<name>.md) and unique in its bank; [[name]] links it.

orientation.description: The memories every session always sees, at most five, each body at most 600 bytes and 1,500 bytes in all.

owners.description: A team bank's owners: the forge logins that approve its reviewed changes, at least one.

root.description: orgs when the bank has re-tiered its root breadcrumbs to org headers, each org then indexing at most 40; absent otherwise.

memories.description: Where a bank's memories are: the glob, the scope template and the memory schema, the same in every bank.

docs.description: The bank's documents beside its memories, by glob.

land.description: How a change lands: pull-request on a forge, commit on a local-only bank's main.

memories.description: How a change of only memories lands: auto merges once the bank's check passes; review waits for an owner.

items.description: A class of change held for review: orientation, decisions, a status, or the manifest.

merge.description: A bank's own merge rule: memories auto or review, and the reviewed classes, every one of orientation, decisions, status and manifest, which always wait for review.

write.description: Where a memory is written, how a change lands and the bank's merge rule.

description: A bank's BANK.md frontmatter: name, kind, purpose, entities, orientation, a team's owners, the memory layout, the documents and the write rule.
